entry.summary:
Mihingarangi Forbes questions Police Minister Mark Mitchell about the decision to end Operation Cranmere after just eight months without any arrests | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

Police had previously stated Tom Phillips received help while on the run with his children for four years.

Full story: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/crime-and-justice/847951/he-was-a-dictator-mother-of-marokopa-children-speaks-out-about-her-relationship-with-tom-phillips
